data.name: Starr
data.gender_notes: Starr is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word astēr or Latin stella, meaning star, a name that symbolizes a shining light, often used metaphorically for a person who brings hope, guidance, or enlightenment to others. In Christianity, stars are associated with the divine and the celestial realm. The name Starr carries the meaning “A shining light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Starr usually hope their child will grow to embody a shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Starr total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
